purpose: Confirm each runtime source PDF is the authoritative Gazette of India publication, not only a copy hosted by the Department of Consumer Affairs. Machine verification (V1-V6) compares a PDF with itself; this check compares the PDF with a second, independently hosted official copy.
performed_by: machine (coding agent); not a human or lawyer review
method: Downloaded the e-Gazette copy and compared SHA-256 with the file in originals/. Where a differently produced copy existed, compared every runtime provision word-for-word against its text layer.
notes: egazette.nic.in no longer resolves; the same WriteReadData paths are served by egazette.gov.in.

The e-Gazette IDs for ECR 2020 and ECR 2021 were found via secondary articles; the JUR 2021 ID was taken from the DCA file name (232278_...). All three IDs are confirmed only by the byte-identical download, not by the citing pages.

official_copies.host: thc.nic.in (High Court of Tripura, government host)
official_copies.pdf_producer: iLovePDF (re-processed copy; weaker witness than the e-Gazette file)

provision_text_comparison.JURISDICTION_RULES_2021_CANDIDATE_A_P005: operative text matches; stored text continues past the rule into the signature block ('ANUPAM MISHRA, Jt. Secy.' plus the digital-signature stamp 'SURENDER MAHADASAM MAHADASAM') and skips '[F. No. J-9/1/2020-CPU]'

amendment_search.ECR_2020: Secondary sources show only the 2020 corrigendum (G.S.R. 488(E)), G.S.R. 328(E) (2021) and G.S.R. 789(E) (2026, effective 2027-01-01). Matches manifest.json. No 2022-2025 amendment found.
amendment_search.JURISDICTION_RULES_2021: No amendment found in secondary sources.
amendment_search.limit: Absence in web search is not proof of absence; e-Gazette has no queryable index from here.

defects_found: JURISDICTION_RULES_2021_CANDIDATE_A_P005 was machine_verified and in the runtime corpus, but its stored text included the signatory and digital-signature stamp. V5 checked only for a cut-off proviso after the span, not for non-law text inside it.

changes: V5 now rejects stored text containing a signatory line, file number, gazette footer, digital-signature name lines, or the next chapter heading. Text is rejected, never trimmed by code.
A source is machine_verified only if official_copy.result is byte_identical against egazette.gov.in and its hash equals document_sha256; the acceptance gate enforces the same rule.
resolution.rerun_result: official_copy byte_identical for all three sources; P005 now rejected (V5_non_law_text); runtime corpus rebuilt with 7 provisions, gate PASS.
